title: Tree rotation
contract: Rotate a three-node BST without changing key order or membership.
scope: Strictly increasing triples drawn from -2..2; single left rotation at root.
assumptions: Exactly the abstract finite model and input domain described in scope; no claim about LLMLang implementation or unbounded executions.

obligations.claim: In-order sequence equals original and all three keys are retained; rotated root is original right child.
